command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git pull --ff-only origin integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
rm -f sdkconfig.old
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "a5caed474944bcfa34336cf582b5f9453f955f05" ]
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('tests/host/test_gateway_inputs.c')
data = p.read_bytes()
needle = b"'\x00'"
if needle not in data:
    raise SystemExit('literal NUL char test defect not found')
p.write_bytes(data.replace(needle, b"'\\0'", 1))
PY
git diff --check
file tests/host/test_gateway_inputs.c
git diff -- tests/host/test_gateway_inputs.c
